_comment: The one file that binds the agent tooling (tools/agent-workflow, .agents/, hooks) to THIS repository. Every project-specific value the tools need lives here; everything else derives the root from the tools' own location. Validated by tools/agent-workflow/project_config.py; checked and applied by tools/agent-workflow/setup_project.py. After copying the tooling to another repository, edit this file, then run `setup_project.py apply` and `setup_project.py check` (skill: .agents/skills/agent-setup).
